hypothesis.claim: Execute the controller-owned rmp_area_power recipe as a fresh recipe-transition experiment: reconstruct and checkpoint the inherited low-power state, then run the single bounded area restructure pass. In Restructure.cpp, refine only the existing area-mode cloud admission and snapshot/restore path. Permit at most four legal combinational endpoint clouds with finite STA context to enter real ABC area trials; emit rmp_area_attempted only at that point. Evaluate the resulting cloud with the existing local area, liberty-cell leakage, wire, timing, electrical, legality, and HPWL checks. Retain at most one cloud only when measured local area or leakage proxy strictly improves and all global guards remain satisfied; otherwise restore the snapshot. Emit rmp_area_retained only after a non-restored acceptance. Preserve all controller budgets, ABC modes, generated Liberty handling, repair_power behavior, public commands, and ordinary repair_timing.
